x-k-k9-01.title: Codsi aan cadayn oo ka yimid hogaamiyaha kooxda

x-k-k9-01.goal: Go'aami macluumaadkee runtii maqan ee codsi gaaban oo macnaha guud badan ee sare, oo si edeb leh u weydii kuwaas oo keliya jawaab.
x-k-k9-01.material:
Waxaad tahay 박 사원, shaqaale yar. 6:40 p.m. 팀장 (hogaamiyaha kooxda) ayaa kuu diraya fariintan:

"박 사원님, 내일 오전 회의에서 쓸 자료 좀 정리해 주세요. 지난번처럼 부탁해요."

Waxaad ogtahay:
- Bishii hore waxaad 팀장 u samaysay laba nooc oo agab: 월간 실적 요약 (soo koobidda natiijooyinka bishii) iyo 신제품 일정표 (jadwalka badeecadda cusub). Labaduba waxay ahaayeen isla qaab.
- Fariintu ma sheegto waqtiga uu kulanku bilaabmayo.
- Waxaad dirtaa HAL fariin jawaab ah kahor intaadan bilaabin.

x-k-k9-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma qirtay waxa erayadu ii sheegi karin?
x-k-k9-03.s.s2.model.0: Waxaan doortay 한번 생각해 보겠습니다. Waa aan cadayn sababtoo ah ma aqbalo, ma bixiyo taariikh ama sabab, sidaa darteed waxay noqon kartaa maya jilicsan. Waan raaci lahaa oo weydiin lahaa haddii miisaaniyadda rubuca xiga suurtagal tahay.
x-k-k9-03.s.s2.model.1: 이번 분기 예산은 이미 확정되어서요 gudaheeda eraygu 이미 ('mar hore') wuxuu muujinayaa miisaaniyaddu way xiran tahay, taas oo soo jeedinaysa diidmo edeb leh hadda. Waan xaqiijin lahaa haddii aan mar kale weydiin karno rubuca xiga.
x-k-k9-03.s.s2.modelNote.1: Caddayn xoog leh oo hal eray ah, oo leh tallaabo xigta.
x-k-k9-03.s.s2.model.2: Weerka 다음 분기 예산을 짤 때 wuxuu tilmaamayaa maya rubucan, sababtoo ah bixintu waa la dib u dhigay oo keliya. Waan weydiin lahaa haddii kulanka miisaaniyadda rubuca xiga yahay waqtiga saxda ah oo aan xaqiijin lahaa taariikh.

x-k-k9-04.title: U habee warbixinta jadwalka
x-k-k9-04.topic: Wakhtiyada kama dambaysta ah jadwal gudihiisa (dhis dhowr xal)
x-k-k9-04.goal: U beddel xeerarka jadwalka ee maamulaha xaddidaadyo tiro ah, ka hel dhowr jadwal oo dhammaantood qanciya, oo xisaabi bilowga ugu dambeeya ee suurtagalka ah.
x-k-k9-04.material:
팀장 kaaga wuxuu kuu soo diraa fariintan 10-ka bisha:

"이번 보고서 일정을 짜 주세요. ① 자료를 12일 아침에 받으니까 초안은 12일부터 쓸 수 있어요. ② 팀원 검토에는 이틀이 걸리니까, 검토가 끝나는 날은 초안이 끝난 날보다 이틀 이상 뒤여야 합니다. ③ 부장님 확인은 팀원 검토가 끝난 다음 날 이후에 받을 수 있는데, 부장님이 20일에 출장을 가시니까 19일까지는 받아야 해요."

Isticmaal maalinta bisha sida tiro dhan. d = maalinta qoraalka hore la dhammeeyo, r = maalinta dib u eegista kooxdu dhammaato, b = maalinta 부장님 hubiyo.
x-k-k9-04.thinking.1: Helista dhowr xal oo wada qancinaya
x-k-k9-04.thinking.2: Dib u shaqayn laga bilaabo wakhti kama dambays ah ilaa bilowga ugu dambeeya
x-k-k9-04.prereq.0: Wuu akhriyi karaa taariikhaha Kuuriyaanka ee sida 12일 la qoray iyo weero sida 이틀 이상 iyo 다음 날
x-k-k9-04.prereq.1: Wuu yaqaan 초안 (qoraal hore), 검토 (dib u eegid) iyo 출장 (safar ganacsi)
x-k-k9-04.s.s1.prompt: Haddii qoraalka hore la dhammeeyo 13-ka, waa maxay maalinta ugu horreysa ee dib u eegista kooxdu dhammaan karto, marka loo eego ②?
x-k-k9-04.s.s1.hint.0: Ka hel qaybta weedha ② ee sheegta intee dambe dib u eegistu dhammaato.
x-k-k9-04.s.s1.hint.1: Hubi jawaabtaada adigoo tiriya maalmaha u dhexeeya 13-ka iyo maalintaada: ma farqigu wuxuu ku habboon yahay '이틀 이상'?
x-k-k9-04.s.s1.r.a: Ku darista hal maalin oo dheeraad ah waxay muujinaysaa in 이상 ('ama ka badan') loo qaatay 'ka badan'.
x-k-k9-04.s.s1.r.b: Akhrinta 이틀 이상 뒤 sida maalinta xigta kaliya waxay muujinaysaa in qaybta 'laba maalmood' aan la tirin.
x-k-k9-04.s.s1.r.c: Tirinta laba maalmood oo dhan 13-ka ka dib waxay muujinaysaa 이틀 이상 뒤 sida la qoray loo akhriyay.
x-k-k9-04.s.s1.explain: 이틀 이상 뒤 macnaheedu waa laba maalmood ama ka badan ka dib: 13 + 2 = 15. Sidaa darteed kan ugu horreeya waa 15-ka.
x-k-k9-04.s.s2.prompt: Ka hel 3 jadwal oo kala duwan (d, r, b) oo raacaya ①, ② iyo ③ dhammaantood.
x-k-k9-04.s.s2.hint.0: Xeer kasta u qor sida hal barbardhig oo u dhexeeya laba tiro ka hor intaadan tijaabin qiyam.
x-k-k9-04.s.s2.hint.1: Marka hore go'aami maalinta qoraalka hore, kadibna dooro maalinta dib u eegista, ugu dambayn maalinta 부장님.
x-k-k9-04.s.s2.hint.2: Haddii jadwal fashilmo, hubi xeerka uu jebiyo adigoo tijaabinaya saddexda xeer mid mid.
x-k-k9-04.s.s2.ok.c1: Qoraalka hore ma ahan ka hor imaanshaha agabka (xeerka ①).
x-k-k9-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Dib u eegistu waxay dhammaataa ugu yaraan laba maalmood ka dib qoraalka hore (xeerka ②).
x-k-k9-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Xeerka ②: dib u eegistu waa inay dhammaato ugu yaraan laba maalmood ka dib qoraalka hore.
x-k-k9-04.s.s2.ok.c3: Hubinta 부장님 waa dib u eegista ka dib (xeerka ③).
x-k-k9-04.s.s2.fail.c3: Xeerka ③: hubinta 부장님 waa laga bilaabo maalinta ka dib dhammaadka dib u eegista.
x-k-k9-04.s.s2.ok.c4: La dhammeeyay ka hor safarka 20-ka (xeerka ③).
x-k-k9-04.s.s2.fail.c4: Xeerka ③: 부장님 wuxuu bixi 20-ka, sidaa darteed waa inay noqotaa 19-ka ugu dambayn.
x-k-k9-04.s.s2.explain: Jadwal badan ayaa shaqeeya, tusaale ahaan 12 / 14 / 15 ama 14 / 18 / 19. Marka xigta, eeg xaaladda xad-dhaafka ah: intee dambe maalinta qoraalka hore u dhaqaaqi karaa?
x-k-k9-04.s.s2.because.prompt: Waa maxay maalinta ugu dambeysa ee qoraalka hore (d) la dhammayn karo si saddexda xeer weli loo hayn karo? Sii maalinta, oo tus sida aad u ogaatay adigoo magacaabaya maalinta dib u eegista (r) iyo maalinta 부장님 (b) ee ay keento. Waxaad qori kartaa Ingiriis ama Kuuriyaan.
x-k-k9-04.s.s2.because.hint.0: Dib u shaqee: ku bilow xeerka ugu dambeeya (wakhtiga kama dambaysta ee 부장님) oo u gudub maalinta ka hor, kadibna dib xeerka xiga.
x-k-k9-04.s.s2.because.hint.1: Magacaab maalin kasta oo jidka ah (b, kadibna r, kadibna d) oo sheeg xeerka aad u isticmaashay tallaabo kasta.
x-k-k9-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ma dib u shaqeeyay laga bilaabo wakhtiga kama dambaysta ee 부장님 halkii qiyaas?
x-k-k9-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ma sheegi karaa xeerka caddeeya tallaabo kasta oo ka socota b ilaa r ilaa d?
x-k-k9-04.s.s2.because.model.0: Qoraalka hore waa la dhammayn karaa 16-ka ugu dambayn. 부장님 waa inuu hubiyo 19-ka, sidaa darteed dib u eegistu waa inay dhammaato 18-ka (maalinta ka hor), dib u eegistuna waxay dhammaataa laba maalmood ka dib qoraalka hore, sidaa darteed qoraalka hore waa la dhammeeyay 16-ka.

x-k-k9-05.title: Intee adag 'way fiicnaan lahayd'?
x-k-k9-05.topic: Wakhtiyada kama dambaysta ah iyo hadal aan toos ahayn (muuji oo dib u eeg)
x-k-k9-05.goal: Dib u eeg xukunkaaga intee adag wakhti kama dambays ah marka caddayn cusub timaado, kadibna si edeb leh u xaqiiji qorshaha.
x-k-k9-05.material: Adigu waxaad tahay 박 대리 shirkad yar. Macluumaad ku saabsan warbixin macmiil ah ayaa timaadda saddex qaybood. Qayb kasta ka dib, dooro waxa ugu macquulsan ee la rumaysan karo ama la samayn karo.
x-k-k9-05.thinking.2: Dib u eegidda xukun iyo xaqiijintiisa
x-k-k9-05.prereq.0: Wuu akhriyi karaa fariimo goob shaqo Kuuriyaan ah oo gaaban
x-k-k9-05.prereq.1: Wuu yaqaan 되면 좋겠네요 sida 'way fiicnaan lahayd haddii la samayn karo'
x-k-k9-05.s.s1.prompt: Go'aami intee adag wakhtiga kama dambaysta ah ka dib macluumaad cusub kasta.
x-k-k9-05.s.s1.hint.0: Qayb kasta ka dib, weydii: erayadee ayaa jilicsan, erayadee na waqti ama qof go'aamiya?
x-k-k9-05.s.s1.hint.1: Il kasta, weydii sida ay u ogaan karto waxa ay sheegto, iyo haddii ay ku darto xaqiiqo cusub ama kaliya ku celiso mid hore.
x-k-k9-05.s.s1.st.0.info: 부장님 wuxuu marinka ku yidhi: "박 대리, 거래처 보고서는 이번 주 안에 되면 좋겠네요."
x-k-k9-05.s.s1.st.0.ask: Fariintan oo keliya ku salaysan, intee adag wakhtiga kama dambaysta ah?
x-k-k9-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Erayadu way jilicsan yihiin, laakiin muddo waqti ah ayaa la magacaabay. Caddayn dheeraad ah la'aan adkaanshuhu waa aan la hubin, sidaa darteed weydiinta ama raadinta macluumaad dheeraad ah waa macquul.
x-k-k9-05.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Waa rabitaan oo keliya, sidaa darteed wuu sugi karaa usbuuca dambe haddii aan mashquulsanahay.
x-k-k9-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Akhrinta 되면 좋겠네요 sida aan xoog lahayn waxay iska indho tirtaa in 이번 주 안에 weli magacaabayo muddo waqti.
x-k-k9-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Waa amar adag: warbixinta waa inay ahaato miiska 부장님 Jimce badhtamaha habeenka.
x-k-k9-05.s.s1.st.0.r.b: U qaadashada erayada jilicsan sida amar adag waxay ku daraysaa faahfaahin fariintu aysan bixin.
x-k-k9-05.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Waa rabitaan usbuucan, laakiin weli ma sheegi karo intee adag.
x-k-k9-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Hayntu akhrinta furan waxay muujinaysaa inaad miisaanto jilicsanaanta iyo muddada la sheegay labadaba.
x-k-k9-05.s.s1.st.1.info: Wada-shaqeeye sare, 정 과장, ayaa si aamusnaan ah kuu sheegaya: "부장님이 '되면 좋겠네요' 하시면 보통은 '그때까지 꼭 보고 싶다'는 뜻이에요. 금요일 아침 회의 전에 보실 거예요."
x-k-k9-05.s.s1.st.1.ask: Sidee tani u beddelaysaa aragtidaada wakhtiga kama dambaysta ah?
x-k-k9-05.s.s1.st.1.after: 정 과장 waxay taqaan caadooyinka 부장님, sidaa darteed wakhtiga kama dambaysta ah waa u badan yahay mid adag; laakiin faahfaahinta (Jimce subaxnimo) waxay ka timaaddaa iyada, ma aha 부장님, sidaa darteed waa caqli inaad xaqiijiso.
x-k-k9-05.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Ilaali aragtidaada: kaliya erayada 부장님 ayaa beddeli kara xukun.
x-k-k9-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Tuurista khibrad la xiriirta waxay muujinaysaa inaad sugayso il kaamil ah.
x-k-k9-05.s.s1.st.1.o.b: U qaado wakhtiga kama dambaysta ah sida inta badan adag, laakiin hubi ka hor intaadan ku tiirin.
x-k-k9-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Kor u qaadidda qiyaastaada adigoo hubin sii haynaya waxay muujinaysaa inaad miisaanto macluumaad gacan labaad ah.
x-k-k9-05.s.s1.st.1.o.c: U qaado wakhtiga kama dambaysta ah sida adag oo ku qorshee Jimce 9 a.m. adigoo aan hubin.
x-k-k9-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Aqbalaadda sheeko lamaane shaqo sida caddayn waxay ku darsataa faahfaahin ka baxsan waxa 부장님 yidhi.
x-k-k9-05.s.s1.st.2.info: Jadwalka wadaagga ah wuxuu muujiyaa: 금요일 오전 9시 임원 회의, iyo qoraalka 부장님 ee "8:30부터 자료 검토". Adiguna waxaad u dirtaa: "목요일 퇴근 전까지 보내 드려도 될까요?" 부장님 ayaa ka jawaabaa: "그래 주면 고맙지요."
x-k-k9-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Waa maxay qorshaha ugu macquulsan hadda?
x-k-k9-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Jadwalku wuxuu muujiyaa goorta 부장님 akhriyo, 그래 주면 고맙지요-na waa heshiis. Khamiista ka hor ka bixitaanka waa badbaado, xaqiijin gaaban-na wuu xidhaa wareegga.
x-k-k9-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: U dir Khamiista ka hor inta aad ka bixin, oo xaqiiji taas fariin gaaban.
x-k-k9-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Isku-darka caddaynta jadwalka iyo jawaabta wuxuu muujiyaa in caddaynta saddexda qaybood oo dhan la isticmaalay.
x-k-k9-05.s.s1.st.2.o.b: U dir Jimcaha 8 a.m., wax yar ka hor kulanka.
x-k-k9-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Tani waxay iska indhatirtaa in 부장님 bilaabo dib u eegista 8:30 oo laga yaabo inuu rabo wakhti uu ku akhriyo.
x-k-k9-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Wax ha samayn weli: 그래 주면 고맙지요 wuxuu u dhawaaqaa edeb keliya, ma aha go'aan.
x-k-k9-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: U arkidda 그래 주면 고맙지요 sida edeb oo keliya waxay muujisaa ka labalabeyn heshiis dadban; halkan wuxuu ka jawaabayaa soo jeedintaada Khamiista.
x-k-k9-05.s.s1.reflect: Fiiro gaar ah u yeelo sida aragtidaadu u dhaqaaqday: laga bilaabo 'rabitaan jilicsan' ilaa 'u badan adag' ilaa qorshe gaar ah, mar kasta sababtoo ah caddayn cusub. Qaybtee ayaa aragtidaada ugu badan beddeshay, miyaa wax ka mid ah ahaa mid qof kale oo keliya laga helay?
x-k-k9-05.s.s2.prompt: Qor fariin rasmi ah oo gaaban 부장님 Kuuriyaan ah oo xaqiijinaysa goorta aad u diri doonto warbixinta.
x-k-k9-05.s.s2.hint.0: Magacaaw maalinta iyo daqiiqadda (tusaale, ka hor inta aad ka bixin) fariinta.
x-k-k9-05.s.s2.hint.1: Isticmaal dhammaad rasmi ah sida -겠습니다 ballan loo qaaday kan ka sarreeya.
x-k-k9-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ballanku ma gaar ku filan yahay in 부장님 ku qorsheeyo?
x-k-k9-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Dhammaadku ma u dhawaaqaa ballan adag oo loo qaaday kan ka sarreeya?
x-k-k9-05.s.s2.modelNote.1: Wuxuu bixiyaa wakhti saacad wuxuuna weydiistaa dib u eegis.
x-k-k9-05.s.s2.modelNote.2: Falal kale oo loogu talagalay dirista waa fiican yihiin.

x-k-k9-06.title: Laga bilaabo sheeko ilaa codsi 부장님
x-k-k9-06.topic: Codsiyada kuwa ka sarreeya (dib u qor akhriste)
x-k-k9-06.goal: Go'aami waxa u baahan in la beddelo marka fariin lamaane shaqo dhow loo diro agaasime, oo dib u qor sida codsi.
x-k-k9-06.material:
Qabyo aad u qortay lamaane shaqo dhow:

"나 내일 병원 예약 있어서 반차 쓸게. 급한 건 민수한테 물어봐."

Hadda waa inaad isla macluumaadkan u dirto 부장님 (agaasime) aad, kan oggolaanaya fasaxa qof walba. 민수 waa lamaane shaqo kara inuu daboolo arrimaha degdegga ah.
x-k-k9-06.thinking.2: Ilaalinta nuxurka iyadoo codka la beddelayo
x-k-k9-06.prereq.0: Wuxuu yaqaan farqiga u dhexeeya 반말 iyo qaabka -ㅂ니다/-습니다
x-k-k9-06.s.s1.prompt: Gaar ahaan 부장님, beddelaadee ayaa loo baahan yahay? Dooro dhammaan kuwa quseeya.
x-k-k9-06.s.s1.hint.0: Liis garee waxa qabyadu sameyso: ogeysiisaa, weydiisataa, mise amartaa. Kuwee 부장님 filayo fasax?
x-k-k9-06.s.s1.hint.1: Hoos u xariiq eray kasta oo qabyada ah oo aadan ku odhan lahayn agaasime, ka dibna go'aami haddii qaabka edebta leh weli ku habboon yahay ogeysiis.
x-k-k9-06.s.s1.o.a: Ku dar 요 dhammaadyada oo keliya (쓸게요, 물어봐요) oo wax kale ku hay
x-k-k9-06.s.s1.r.a: Ku darista 요 waxay jilcisaa fariinta sheekada, laakiin 나 iyo magaca qaawan 민수 way sii caadi yihiin, 물어봐요 weli wuxuu u dhawaaqaa sida amar, 쓸게요-na weli wuxuu ogeysiiyaa fasaxa.
x-k-k9-06.s.s1.o.b: Tirtir sababta, sababtoo ah sharaxaadda sababta aad u baahan tahay fasax waa aan edeb ahayn
x-k-k9-06.s.s1.r.b: Fikradda ah in sabab la qariyo waxay muujisaa xeer la dabaqay iyadoo aan la hubin haddii sababtu u faa'iidaysay dhagaystaha.
x-k-k9-06.s.s1.o.c: Weydii haddii 부장님 oggolaanayo fasaxa halkii la ogeysiin lahaa go'aanka
x-k-k9-06.s.s1.r.c: Aragtida in 쓸게 ogeysiinayo wax u baahan oggolaansho waxay muujisaa inaad barbar dhigtay ficilka, ma aha dhammaadyada oo keliya.
x-k-k9-06.s.s1.o.d: U sheeg 부장님 go'aanka, qaab edeb leh oo keliya (반차를 쓰겠습니다), weydiin la'aan
x-k-k9-06.s.s1.r.d: Dhammaadyada edebta ahi waxay saxaan heerka hadalka laakiin ma saxaan ficilka: 부장님 wuu oggolaadaa fasaxa, sidaas darteed ogeysiis weli ma siinayo fursad oggolaansho.
x-k-k9-06.s.s1.o.e: U beddel magac-bedelka, dhammaadyada iyo magaca qaawan 민수 qaabab edeb leh
x-k-k9-06.s.s1.r.e: Aragtida magac-bedelka, dhammaadyada iyo magaca wada jir ahaan waxay muujisaa inaad hubisay weedhda oo dhan.
x-k-k9-06.s.s1.explain: Laba wax ayaa isbeddelaya: ficilka (ogeysiis wuxuu noqonayaa codsi oggolaansho) iyo qaababka (나, 쓸게, 물어봐 iyo magaca qaawan 민수 waa caadi). Sababta iyo gacan-gudbintu waa inay sii jiraan: waxay caawiyaan 부장님 inuu go'aamiyo.
x-k-k9-06.s.s2.prompt: Dib u qor fariinta 부장님 Kuuriyaan. Ku hay sababta, fasaxa badh-maalinta iyo gacan-gudbinta 민수.
x-k-k9-06.s.s2.hint.0: Dooro hal qaab codsi (tusaale -(으)ㄹ까요? ama 허락해 주시면 감사하겠습니다) oo inta kale ku hay dhammaad rasmi ah.
x-k-k9-06.s.s2.hint.1: Ku dar 씨 ama magac sharaf 민수, oo dooro hadal gacan-gudbinta oo aan 부장님 amar siinin.
x-k-k9-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma cadda inay tahay codsi, ma aha go'aan?
x-k-k9-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Eray caadi ah kasta ma la beddelay?
x-k-k9-06.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma 부장님 ayaa go'aamin kara fariinta oo keliya?
x-k-k9-06.s.s2.modelNote.3: Qaab codsi rasmi ah (신청드립니다) sidoo kale waa fiican yahay.

x-k-k9-07.title: Diidmada codsi dhammaadka toddobaadka
x-k-k9-07.topic: Diidmooyin dadban oo loo diro kuwa ka sarreeya

x-k-k9-09.goal: Is barbardhig qoraalka kulanka iyo waxa la yidhi, hel xariiqda aan raacin, oo dib u qor qaabka qoraalka kulanka.
x-k-k9-09.material:
Qayb ka mid ah waxa kulanka lagu yidhi:

팀장: "시안은 이번 주 금요일까지 받겠습니다. 수정에는 보통 하루가 걸리니까 다음 주 화요일까지 끝내 주세요. 최종 보고는 수정이 끝난 다음 날 오전에 하겠습니다."
이 대리: "시안은 제가 맡겠습니다. 수정은 최 사원이 해 주면 좋겠는데요."
최 사원: "네, 그렇게 하겠습니다. 월요일은 제가 연차라서, 화요일에 바로 하겠습니다."
